title: Air-Fried Crispy Chicken with Lime Leaf & Lemongrass Stir Fry Sauce

items: 2 tbsp @boombayway Lime leaf + Lemon grass Stir Fry sauce for the marinade

method: Marinate the diced chicken in the Lime leaf + Lemongrass Stir Fry sauce and set aside for a few hours in the fridge
Add the rice flour to the chicken and coat evenly
Add to an airfryer at 185 degrees and cook for 5-8 minutes till golden, crunchy and cooked through
While the chicken is cooking, add the @boombayway Five Chilli Oil to a pan and add in vegetables of your choice and stir fry
Add in the Lime leaf + Lemongrass Stir Fry sauce to the pan and mix together
caption:
Introducing Airfried Crispy Chicken with @boombayway’s Lime leaf + Lemongrass Stir Fry sauce with no bad oils and no refined sugar that is high protein | low carbs | easy dinner recipe | low effort | 30 minute recipe

Ingredients
450 grams chicken breast, cubed
2 tbsp rice flour 
2 tbsp @boombayway Lime leaf + Lemon grass Stir Fry sauce for the marinade
1 tbsp @boombayway Five Chilli Oil
Your favourite vegetables of choice 
( I’ve gone with basic onions and capsicum, you can use mushrooms, broccoli, zucchini, bell peppers) 
1/4 cup @boombayway Lime leaf + Lemon grass Stir Fry sauce for glaze
1 tsp white sesame seeds

Method
marinate the diced chicken in the Lime leaf + Lemongrass Stir Fry sauce and set aside for a few hours in the fridge
add the rice flour to the chicken and coat evenly
add to an airfryer at 185 degrees and cook for 5-8 minutes till golden, crunchy and cooked through 
while the chicken is cooking, add the @boombayway Five Chilli Oil to a pan and add in vegetables of your choice and stir fry
add in the Lime leaf + Lemongrass Stir Fry sauce to the pan and mix together 
follow that up with the air fried chicken, toss it all together and serve with some white sesame seeds and enjoy :)
